name: Klaus-Dieter Richter
bio:
Klaus-Dieter's fascination with motorsport began in his childhood, watching Formula 1 races with his father. This passion led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in aerodynamics. He quickly rose through the ranks at smaller racing teams, proving his exceptional problem-solving abilities and meticulous attention to detail. His approach to technical direction is collaborative, fostering open communication and creative solutions within his team. 

At Trident, Klaus-Dieter aims to blend proven engineering principles with cutting-edge innovations. He believes in empowering his team to take calculated risks and learn from failures. His distinctive edge lies in his ability to translate complex data into actionable strategies, ensuring the team stays ahead of the competition through constant improvement and adaptation. He is driven by the pursuit of perfection and a desire to push the boundaries of what's technically possible.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: A man of average height with a focused gaze and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rapidly when deep in thought.
Insists on a daily afternoon coffee break to brainstorm with the team.
